features.title: Offline SQLite Queueing
features.summary: Automatically captures and holds encrypted telemetry and photos during network blackouts.
instructions: Initiate scene recording via the primary shell command or interface.
If network connectivity drops, the header telemetry indicator shifts to 'OFFLINE_BUFFER'.
Do not forcibly power off device while 'Pending Queue' count is above 0.
features.troubleshooting: If queue fails to flush upon reconnecting, run `trust-shell sync --force` from local console.

features.title: TPM 2.0 / Secure Enclave Signing
features.summary: Binds every payload and scene photo to hardware cryptoprocessor keys before writing to buffer.
instructions: Verify system startup shows 'HARDWARE_BOUND' status on boot.
All generated HMAC signatures are auto-appended to payload metadata headers.
If hardware key context breaks, the app switches to software fallback mode with an audit flag.
features.troubleshooting: Re-run `trust-shell-tpm-init` if hardware context path `/var/lib/trust_shell/tpm_hmac.ctx` is lost.

features.title: Journald Audit Logging & Local Purge
features.summary: Writes cryptographically verified delivery receipts to systemd journald before zero-filling local SQLite records.
instructions: Upon receipt of valid server signature (X-Trust-Main-Signature), payload is logged to journald.
Local SQLite row is immediately deleted via `DELETE FROM payload_queue`.
No manual intervention required; purge is fully automated.
features.troubleshooting: Inspect audit logs via `sudo journalctl -u trust-shell.service -g TRUST-AUDIT`.
